# SwiftUI slider references

Build `examples/swiftui-slider` with `scripts/build-ios-sim.sh`. Install and
launch it on the iPhone 18 Pro simulator running iOS 27.2. Capture the resting
screen in light and dark appearance at 3× with status-bar normalization.

`slider` and `slider-dark` show custom marks, a neutral value, a stepped
slider, and a legacy slider. The native marks are below the track. A drag on
Playback records one start and one end in the Edits label.
